% Source: TeX Live 2025 tkz-euclide manual, TKZdoc-euclide-marking.tex
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \tkzDefPoints{0/0/A,8/6/B}
  \tkzDrawSegment(A,B)
  \tkzMarkSegment[color=brown,size=2pt,pos=.12,mark=z](A,B)
  \tkzMarkSegment[color=blue,pos=.28,mark=oo](A,B)
  \tkzMarkSegment[pos=.44,mark=s,color=red](A,B)
  \tkzMarkSegment[color=green!50!black,pos=.60,mark=s|](A,B)
  \tkzMarkSegment[color=orange,pos=.74,mark=s||](A,B)
  \tkzMarkSegment[color=purple,pos=.88,mark=s|||](A,B)
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
